question_text: Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a cultural and technical approach that improves collaboration, delivery speed, reliability, and shared ownership.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: the practice of frequently integrating code changes and validating them with automated builds and tests.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: the practice of keeping software releasable through automated pipelines while deployment may still require approval.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: the practice of automatically deploying validated changes to production without manual release approval.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: defining and deploying infrastructure through versioned, repeatable descriptive models.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: the property that applying the same operation repeatedly produces the same desired result.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: the divergence of environments over time due to manual or inconsistent changes.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: storing build and release pipeline definitions in version-controlled files such as YAML.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a system that stores build outputs and packages used by later pipeline stages.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: moving testing earlier in the development process to find issues sooner.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a fast test focused on a small unit of code.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a test that verifies components work correctly together.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a test that exercises a complete user or system flow.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a release method with two production-like environments where traffic is switched from old to new.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a release method that sends a small percentage of traffic to a new version before wider rollout.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a release method that gradually replaces old instances with new ones.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a runtime switch that enables or disables behavior without redeploying code.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a source control practice where developers integrate frequently into a main branch with short-lived branches.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: using Git as the source of truth for declarative infrastructure or application state.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: the ability to understand system behavior from external outputs such as logs, metrics, and traces.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: an event record emitted by software or infrastructure.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a numeric measurement over time, such as latency or error rate.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a representation of a request path through distributed services.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a quantitative measurement of some aspect of service reliability.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a target value or range for an SLI over a time window.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: the acceptable amount of unreliability implied by an SLO.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: the organized process for detecting, communicating, mitigating, and learning from service incidents.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: documented operational steps for routine tasks or incident response.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a learning-focused review that avoids personal blame and identifies systemic improvements.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: manual, repetitive operational work that scales linearly and has little enduring value.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: building internal platforms and golden paths that improve developer experience and delivery flow.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a paved, recommended way for teams to build, deploy, and operate services.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: integrating security practices into DevOps workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: static application security testing that analyzes source or compiled code without running it.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: dynamic application security testing that tests a running application from the outside.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: software composition analysis that checks third-party dependencies for risks such as vulnerabilities.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a software bill of materials listing components and dependencies in a software artifact.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a DORA metric measuring how often software is deployed.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a DORA metric measuring how long it takes changes to reach production.
Which DevOps concept best matches this description: a DORA metric measuring the proportion of deployments that cause failures requiring intervention.
